title: records.can_transfer input
description: The packages to check, the state id of the org that would send them, and the transfer's mode ("retrieve": held by that center; anything else: held by that manufacturer, with no center).

records.description: State records as the state system sends them (the mirror's raw, or a phone's upload); only the keys the rules read matter.

holder_state_id.description: null: an org without a state id (then only a record without that id is its own).
